name: DMTPC
summary: DMTPC used low-pressure CF4 gas and optical readout for directional WIMP searches. It operated at the surface at MIT before moving underground to WIPP in New Mexico.
detection_principle: Nuclear recoils leave extended ionization tracks in gas. A CCD images avalanche light, supplemented by charge signals, to reconstruct energy, direction and track head–tail information.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
